methodology: Offline built mall on the 2.5D view (layout 4; the passages come from the shared skeleton). Explicit candidates position the player 40px outside each passage, and enemy AI is frozen through the test driver. Keyboard walking/sprinting crosses the actual scene geometry ten round trips per mode; health/stamina are reset between sprint loops. This checks geometry/input and conservation, not combat, natural travel or human/reference-image recognition. Past half of the 600 s raid clock (slow runners), the same seed is deployed again in a fresh page before the next passage.
